claims.claim: Cloudflare Q2 2026 revenue was $696.1M, up 36% year over year, with current RPO up 35%; operating cash flow was $117.6M and free cash flow $56.4M.

Cloudflare raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $2.864B-$2.870B, while GAAP operating loss widened to $205.7M (29.6% of revenue), preserving a material growth-versus-GAAP-profitability tension for underwriting.

risks.risk: GAAP operating loss materially widened despite strong revenue growth, so margin quality and stock-based/other expense structure remain important underwriting checks.

contradictions.contradiction: Accelerating revenue/RPO and positive free cash flow coexist with a substantially larger GAAP operating loss.

unknowns.unknown: Durability of 35% current-RPO growth and path to sustained GAAP operating profitability.
